fullTextEN: Hello,

fullTextZH: 你知道在中文有一个词叫“入口即化”吗？
fullTextEN: Do you know there's a word in Chinese called 'melts in your mouth'?
The meaning of this word is,
some foods are very soft and delicious.

fullTextZH: 如果你把这种食物放在你的嘴里，
fullTextEN: If you put this kind of food in your mouth,
it will melt.
For example,

fullTextZH: 巧克力，有的巧克力非常好，
fullTextEN: chocolate, some chocolate is very good,

fullTextZH: 然后你如果把很好的巧克力，
fullTextEN: and if you put very good chocolate,
in your mouth,
this chocolate will melt.
Also, for example, some cakes,

fullTextZH: 这个蛋糕可能很软、很好吃，
fullTextEN: this cake might be very soft and delicious,

fullTextZH: 如果你把蛋糕放在嘴里，
fullTextEN: if you put the cake in your mouth,

fullTextZH: 这个蛋糕可能也会化开。
fullTextEN: this cake might also melt.
So Chinese people say,
it's very delicious,
because it 'melts in your mouth'.

fullTextZH: 可是以前，我看到有的人说牛肉，
fullTextEN: But before, I saw some people say beef,
beef,
"Melts in your mouth,"
I didn't believe it at all before.

fullTextZH: 我觉得牛肉，你必须要嚼嚼（to chew），
fullTextEN: I think beef, you have to chew it,
You must bite it,
It's impossible to "melt in your mouth."
But because I went to Japan,
Then at one place,

fullTextZH: 我吃了那个地方非常非常有名的牛肉，
fullTextEN: I ate the very famous beef there,
Ah,
I understood,

fullTextZH: 为什么有的人说这个牛肉很好，
fullTextEN: why some people say this beef is good,
because it "melts in your mouth."

fullTextZH: 好，在日本，我去了一个地方，
fullTextEN: Okay, in Japan, I went to a place,
This place is called Takayama,
Hmm, Takayama.

fullTextZH: 这个地方有很多很多很老的建筑，
fullTextEN: This place has many very old buildings,

fullTextZH: 所以我觉得因为很老的建筑，
fullTextEN: So I think because of the old buildings,
it attracts many tourists.

fullTextZH: 那你去这个地方，你会发现，
fullTextEN: When you go to this place, you will find,
most of the restaurants,
Maybe every restaurant,

fullTextZH: 都会有一种牛肉叫飞弹牛，
fullTextEN: will have a type of beef called Hida beef,
Hida beef, in English is Hida beef,
Hmm,
almost every restaurant has it.
Hida beef, so I think,
Hmm,
Hida beef,

fullTextZH: 为什么每个饭店都卖这一种牛肉？
fullTextEN: Why does every restaurant sell this type of beef?

fullTextZH: 所以那个时候，我觉得我应该试试。
fullTextEN: So at that time, I thought I should try it.
Then I tried it twice,
The first time was like this,

fullTextZH: 这一次的牛肉不是“入口即化”，
fullTextEN: This time the beef wasn't 'melt in your mouth',
but it was very delicious.

fullTextZH: 我觉得因为这种牛肉有很多油，
fullTextEN: I think because this type of beef has a lot of fat,

fullTextZH: 所以你吃，你会觉得，哦，很香，
fullTextEN: so when you eat it, you feel, oh, very fragrant,
with a fragrant aroma of fat.
Is it 'zhī' or 'zhǐ' for fat?
Yes, I think it's so delicious,

fullTextZH: 我吃完，第二天我还在回味，
fullTextEN: After I ate it, I was still savoring it the next day,

fullTextZH: 嗯，前一天的牛肉太好吃了。
fullTextEN: Hmm, the beef from the day before was so delicious.
Okay, then,

fullTextZH: 因为第一次我觉得这个牛肉很好吃，
fullTextEN: Because the first time I thought this beef was very delicious,

fullTextZH: 所以第二天，我决定我要再试试。
fullTextEN: so the next day, I decided I would try again.

fullTextZH: 所以呢，我去了一个烤肉店，
fullTextEN: So, I went to a barbecue restaurant,
Hmm,
The second time was like this,

fullTextZH: 这个烤肉店的牛肉更好。
fullTextEN: The beef at this barbecue restaurant was even better.

fullTextZH: 所以我把这个牛肉放在我的嘴里，
fullTextEN: So I put this beef in my mouth,

fullTextZH: 然后我真的觉得它化了，
fullTextEN: then I really felt it melt,
Not really,

fullTextZH: 但是你真的感觉这个牛肉非常好，
fullTextEN: but you really feel this beef is very good,
very tender, very delicious.
At that time,
At that moment,

fullTextZH: 我真的明白了什么是“入口即化”的牛肉。
fullTextEN: I really understood what 'melts in your mouth' beef is.

fullTextZH: 对，因为那个牛肉太软了，
fullTextEN: Yes, because that beef was so tender,
you don't need to chew,
you don't need to chew hard,
you can swallow it directly.
Hmm,
So delicious,

fullTextZH: 我现在还记得那个感觉。
fullTextEN: I still remember that feeling now.
Okay,
So if you go to Japan,

fullTextZH: 你一定要试试这个牛肉，叫Hida beef，
fullTextEN: You must try this beef, called Hida beef,
Very delicious.

fullTextZH: 你有没有吃过“入口即化”的东西？
fullTextEN: Have you ever eaten something that melts in your mouth?
Leave a comment and tell me,
Okay, see you next time, bye.
